# Command line

## Server manager (`pauru`)

The installer links itself as `/usr/local/bin/pauru`. Run it as root; without arguments it opens a menu.

```
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MenderBaga/PauruBot/main/install.sh)
install.sh install --domain bot.example.com --token 123:ABC --owner 123456 [--channel stable|beta] [--version v1.2.3] [--https-port 443]
install.sh update [--channel stable|beta] [--version v1.2.3]
install.sh rollback | status | logs [service] | restart | backup | restore FILE | setup-link | uninstall
install.sh enable-agent | disable-agent   (let the admin panel request updates and rollbacks)
```

Actions: `install`, `update`, `rollback`, `status`, `logs`, `restart`, `backup`, `restore`, `setup-link`, `edit`, `uninstall`, `agent`, `enable-agent`, `disable-agent`.

## Application (`paurubot`)

Run inside a container, for example `docker compose exec api paurubot doctor`.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `api` | run the HTTP API (admin panel, Mini App, webhooks) |
| `backup` | write an encrypted backup now (add --send to post it to Telegram) |
| `backup-verify` | check a backup's hashes and, with --full, restore it into a scratch database |
| `backups` | list backups in the backup directory |
| `bot` | run the Telegram bot with long polling |
| `doctor` | check configuration, database, migrations and redis |
| `gen-master-key` | print a new random MASTER_KEY |
| `import-bot` | move customers, balances and services over from another bot (MIG-01) |
| `migrate` | apply database migrations |
| `reconcile` | verify ledger balances against journal entries |
| `restore` | replace the database with a backup (stop api, bot and worker first) |
| `schema-status` | compare the database schema with this release (exit 0 same, 3 older, 4 newer/unknown, 5 empty) |
| `setup-token` | issue a new one-time setup token (only before setup is completed) |
| `worker` | run queues and periodic tasks |
